source_review: All26 original table terms reviewed in their sailing weather/creature/crew/hull context. Complete natural English names; shared warning substitutions retain original templates.

localization_notes.雷: Lightning is the visible dangerous weather phenomenon rather than its sound.
localization_notes.流氷: Drift Ice means floating sea ice, without inventing icebergs.
localization_notes.水漏れ: Leaks retains water ingress without overstating flooding.
localization_notes.謎の泡: Strange Bubbles preserves the unexplained phenomenon.
localization_notes.化け魚: Monster Fish preserves the fantastic creature rather than a named real species.
